chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Mahziyār narrated, saying:

I saw Abū Jaʿfar al-Thānī عليه السلام praying the obligatory prayer and other than it in a jubbah of khazz ṭārūnī, and he clothed me with a jubbah of khazz, and mentioned that he had worn it on his body and prayed in it, and he instructed me to pray in it.

key_terms.خَزٍّ: khazz fabric used for the garment
key_terms.طَارُونِيٍّ: a descriptive type or quality of khazz

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray in a garment made of khazz?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Abū Jaʿfar al-Thānī عليه السلام performed both obligatory and supererogatory prayer in a garment made of khazz and also gave such a garment to ʿAlī ibn Mahziyār to pray in. Its significance is in indicating the permissibility of praying in this type of clothing through the Imam’s action and instruction.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "I saw Abu Ja'far al-Thani (Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Jawad (as)) praying both the obligatory and non-obligatory prayers in a cloak made of fine silk fabric (khazz taruni). He gave me a cloak made of khazz, informed me that he had worn it on his body and prayed in it, and instructed me to pray in it as well."
